scientific_integrity: Analytic self-contained deductions with standard classical weak compactness lemmas and explicitly credited compact-approximation theorem; no external or independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact gap uses Boolean real matrices. Hilbert factorization is proved for injective-graph languages; no effective test for arbitrary languages or optimal factorization constant is asserted. Equivalent earlier weakly almost periodic or stability formulations remain a priority risk.
title: Exact weak-compactness gaps and Hilbert-factorable nonregular language Hankel operators
